animation_kind: ideal target allocation; not measured boundaries

priors.name: GeneZip
priors.description: Retain finer resolution in promoters and genic sequence; compress intronic and intergenic sequence more strongly.
priors.conclusion: The default prior gives the strongest CMP score among these priors, while retaining strong TISP performance.

priors.name: GeneZip-Regulome
priors.description: Shift resolution toward promoter and broader noncoding regulatory context.
priors.conclusion: ETGP AUPRC rises to 0.5049, while CMP SCC falls to 0.1013. The preferred allocation depends on the task.

priors.name: GeneZip-PromoterDistal
priors.description: Prioritize promoters, introns and near-intergenic sequence over genic detail.
priors.conclusion: This prior has the highest eQTL AUROC and TISP PCC in the prior comparison, with lower CMP performance.

priors.name: GeneZip-Intergenic
priors.description: Reverse the default preference: retain finer resolution in distal intergenic sequence.
priors.conclusion: More tokens overall do not guarantee better predictions: TISP PCC is 20.9% below the default prior despite weaker overall compression.
